commit.message:
Handle EXCEPTION_STACK_OVERFLOW when yellow zone is unguarded

The previous code did not handle a corner case that arises when HotSpot
receives `EXCEPTION_STACK_OVERFLOW` (since the guard page cannot be
moved further down) while already processing a recoverable overflow.  In
this case, the yellow and reserved zones are writable (as part of the
recoverable overflow), so we retry the same instruction.  If the
faulting probe reaches the red zone, we'll receive
`EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION`, which will be handled as an unrecoverable
overflow.
